title: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill Taiwanese Student Association (UNC TSA / UNCTSA), known in Chinese as 北卡羅萊納大學教堂山分校台灣同學會, is a registered student organization at UNC Chapel Hill serving Taiwanese students at the university. The organization is listed in the university’s official Heel Life club directory at heellife.unc.edu and maintains an Instagram account (@uncch_tsa), a Facebook group, and a Blogspot-based website that has served as its primary web presence.

According to the organization’s own website, the association provides Taiwanese students a space to build friendships and share experiences at UNC, bringing together Taiwanese students and Chinese-speaking scholars in the broader Chapel Hill area through regularly scheduled activities, with the goal of fostering mutual support and passing on the unique lived experience of Taiwanese students in North Carolina. Annual programming has included trips, dinners, and tri-university exchange events among UNC, Duke, and NC State, as well as new student orientation services such as airport pickups, used furniture sales, and welcome events designed to help incoming students settle in quickly.

The blogspot website’s most recent documented post dates to 2014, and its contact page lists a Facebook group and a Google Groups mailing list as primary communication channels. The Instagram account (@uncch_tsa) reflects a continued presence under the organization’s name. The organization remains registered in the Heel Life university club directory as of the date of this research.
